title: Mutation: Threshold Order Contradiction

revision_history.author: safety_engineer
revision_history.description: Reconciled the expectation with the rule this scenario declares. declared detector 'Parameter threshold order validator' -> rule id 'parameter_threshold_order'; expected description restated as the message the declared rule emits. The rule is authoritative for severity and category. The scenario's injected defect, its affected artifacts and its declared detector rule are unchanged. This expectation had never been checked: the scenario harness matched any finding of the right severity on the right artifact id, so a standing finding on the same artifact satisfied it. Remediation of finding FB2-REV-FND-000032.

patch.description: Invert threshold order of cell_voltage_max: warning 4300 > derating 4200 > shutdown 4100

expected_finding.description: parameter FB2-PRM-000001 threshold order violated: warning=4300, derating=4200, shutdown=4100

impact_paths: Warning triggers after derating/shutdown - logic inverted
expected_remediation: Restore correct threshold order: warning < derating < shutdown
